author: Local Codex intake, not independent architecture approval

findings.trigger: Preflight calls the existing JSONB DTO already version-pinned and proposes serving stored bytes verbatim without re-encoding across codec versions.
evidence: matter_dto.go createdResultDTO has no schemaVersion; encode/decode are ordinary JSON marshal/unmarshal
PostgreSQL18 JSON types documentation distinguishes JSONB normalization from input-text preservation
findings.impact: Proposed wrapper alone cannot establish exact original wire-byte replay or codec compatibility; existing persistence DTO includes requestHash and is not a safe public body.
findings.required_delta: Describe existing domain snapshot accurately. Choose explicit versioned deterministic encoding of immutable data with compatibility tests OR separately preserved wire bytes/status/headers in the command transaction. Explain legacy receipt readability and exact first-response/replay/lookup projection; never expose internal RequestHash.

findings.trigger: OptionA permits headers OR a documented envelope metadata zone while retaining revision strong ETag.
evidence: Candidate api-contracts body provenance changes with read snapshot
RFC9110 section8.8.1 concerns all observable selected representation data
findings.impact: A metadata zone inside the JSON body still changes representation bytes; revision alone is insufficient. Native/INTA ETag observations do not approve a product representation.
findings.required_delta: If recommending stable body, put volatile provenance genuinely outside body (for example defined response headers), pin validator scope and deterministic codec conditions, and list frontend/client header exposure/consumption changes. Otherwise choose a representation validator/CAS alternative and state the contract trade-off.

findings.trigger: BG04 proposes400 for wrong media type and422 for wrong type as mirroring native, but later T26 asks415-vs400; candidate/native use different rows.
evidence: candidate API table400 includes JSON/syntax/type errors
findings.impact: No deterministic expected result for strict decoder/Content-Type tests; native precedent is misdescribed.
findings.required_delta: Give one explicit product matrix for unsupported/missing Content-Type, charset handling, malformed/trailing JSON, wrong root/field type, unknown/duplicate/forbidden fields and business validation. Clearly label any candidate change; keep native behavior unchanged.

findings.trigger: Suggested core port PrincipalResolver.ResolveRequest(ctx, headers) makes the core abstraction depend on HTTP request shape.
evidence: Existing MatterService accepts trusted primitive ActorID supplied by boundary
findings.impact: Proposed port couples application identity lookup to transport concerns, despite no imported HTTP type being shown. This is a proposal concern, not a defect in nonexistent code.
findings.required_delta: Keep header extraction and token verification at the inbound/identity-adapter boundary. If core needs identity lookup, accept a minimal verified issuer/subject or transport-neutral identity value. State how test-only identity cannot be selected by product config and how claims become trusted; no real provider choice.

scope: Four narrow proposal corrections, no new product source defect asserted; do not reopen BE01
